Upper_Enclosure.desc: Upper shell: OLED window, UI button, finger tunnel, fingertip stop, reaction ceiling

Lower_Enclosure.desc: Lower shell / chassis: mechanism, electronics and battery bays; slots for knob and release

Finger_Support.desc: Finger-support plate: trough, plunger aperture, MAX30102 window; clamps the plunger stack

Plunger_Body.material: Acetal (POM) or SLA resin; machined for repeatability
Plunger_Body.desc: Hollow plunger: optical bore, spring flange with latch lead-in chamfer, window counterbore

Contact_Pad.material: Optically clear PC / PMMA / glass (TBD; skin-contact + optical test)
Contact_Pad.desc: Transparent contact window: blanches the pulp while the camera views through it

Compression_Spring.desc: Compression spring; length follows mechanism state; rate NOT assigned

Spring_Seat.desc: Spring seat washer on optical bracket

Guide.desc: Plunger guide tube: flange bore, cocking-pin slot, latch window, integral latch pivot lug

Travel_Stop.material: Acetal / PETG; shim stack for stroke calibration
Travel_Stop.desc: Travel-stop ring: hard upper limit for the flange; retains plunger and spring

Cocking_Feature.material: Steel dowel pin pressed into printed knob
Cocking_Feature.desc: Radial cocking pin + knob (+Y side). Pull down to cock; pin also keys plunger rotation

Release_Trigger.material: Acetal / PETG (FDM fine layer) - fatigue test
Release_Trigger.desc: Pivoting latch lever: tooth holds flange when cocked; release button rotates it clear

Release_Button.desc: Mechanical release button (-Y side) - separate from the electronic UI button

Latch_Return_Spring.desc: Latch return spring: biases tooth into engagement; length follows lever angle

Optical_Mount.desc: Removable optical bracket: camera pocket, ring-LED collar (centres spring), FPC groove

Camera_Module.desc: Camera envelope (stiffener + lens holder + barrel); replace with selected module drawing

Ring_LED.material: Ring PCB with white/RGB LEDs (colour-consistent, TBD)
Ring_LED.desc: Ring-LED illumination around lens; LEDs inside plunger bore

MAX30102_Module.desc: PPG module; sensor face flush with trough through the support-plate window

Sensor_Mount.desc: MAX30102 pedestal; position set by ppg_mount_position

OLED_Module.desc: OLED module envelope: PCB, glass, header

Display_Window.desc: Replaceable clear display lens bonded into roof recess

Electronics_Tray.desc: Removable electronics carrier: PCB standoffs, charger rails, cable notches; retains battery

ESP32_S3_Board.material: Custom carrier PCB + ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 (N16R8 suggested, TBD)
ESP32_S3_Board.desc: ESP32-S3 carrier envelope incl. camera FPC connector

Charging_Board.desc: Charger board envelope with USB-C receptacle at rear wall

Battery.material: 1S Li-ion/LiPo - chemistry, capacity, protection NOT selected
Battery.desc: Configurable battery envelope with cable-exit tab

Battery_Cover.desc: Flush battery access cover (2x M2 countersunk)

Camera_FPC.desc: Camera FPC route: optical-mount groove -> rear bay -> ESP32 connector (clear of moving parts)

Button_PCB.desc: Small switch PCB on two roof bosses

screw_lib.Screw_M2x30_SHCS: ISO 4762 M2x30 socket head (shell joining, from below)
screw_lib.Screw_M2x8_CSK_Top: ISO 10642 M2x8 countersunk (finger-support plate, from above)
screw_lib.Screw_M2x4_CSK_Bottom: ISO 10642 M2x4 countersunk (mounts / battery cover, from below)
screw_lib.Screw_M2x5_Pan: ISO 7045 M2x5 pan head (tray, PCBs, latch pivot)
